entries.source:
おやびん、
くやしいっス!
entries.note: agent draft 2026-09-28; continue-screen line (reuses dialogue wording where identical)

entries.source:
おやびんの負けっス!
ムチャ残念っス!
entries.note: agent draft 2026-09-28; continue-screen line (reuses dialogue wording where identical)

entries.source:
このあとも、
素敵なおしおきが
待ってるっス!
entries.ko:
이 뒤에도
멋진 벌칙이
기다리고 있슴다!
entries.note: agent draft 2026-09-28; continue-screen line (reuses dialogue wording where identical)

entries.source:
このあとも、
素敵なお姉様が
待ってるっス!
entries.ko:
이 뒤에도
멋진 누님들이
기다리고 있슴다!
entries.note: agent draft 2026-09-28; continue-screen line (reuses dialogue wording where identical)

entries.source:
ここでやめたら
男がすたるっスよ!
entries.note: agent draft 2026-09-28; continue-screen line (reuses dialogue wording where identical)
agent draft 2026-09-28; continue-screen line (reuses dialogue wording where identical)
agent draft 2026-09-28; continue-screen line (reuses dialogue wording where identical)

entries.source:
あっはっは!
女子高生に負けてるし～!
entries.note: agent draft 2026-09-28; continue-screen line (reuses dialogue wording where identical)

entries.source:
もう、おしまい? あんたって
ホンットに根性ないわね!
entries.ko:
벌써 끝이야?
너 진짜 근성 하나도 없네!
entries.note: agent draft 2026-09-28; continue-screen line (reuses dialogue wording where identical)

entries.source:
ははは!
やっぱり日本人は麻雀弱いな!
entries.note: agent draft 2026-09-28; continue-screen line (reuses dialogue wording where identical)

entries.source:
どうした?
もう諦めるのか、日本人!
entries.note: agent draft 2026-09-28; continue-screen line (reuses dialogue wording where identical)

entries.source:
あっはっは!
正義は勝つのだ!
entries.note: agent draft 2026-09-28; continue-screen line (reuses dialogue wording where identical)

entries.source:
やめちゃうの?
ねぇ、もっと遊ぼうよ!
entries.note: agent draft 2026-09-28; continue-screen line (reuses dialogue wording where identical)

entries.source:
勝負にすら、
ならなかったわね。
entries.note: agent draft 2026-09-28; continue-screen line (reuses dialogue wording where identical)

entries.source: あら、もうおしまい? 最低ね。
entries.note: agent draft 2026-09-28; continue-screen line (reuses dialogue wording where identical)

entries.source:
勝負は時の運。
ツイてなかったね!
entries.note: agent draft 2026-09-28; continue-screen line (reuses dialogue wording where identical)

entries.source:
もう、やめちゃうの?
つまんないなぁ!
entries.note: agent draft 2026-09-28; continue-screen line (reuses dialogue wording where identical)

entries.source:
あっはっは!
あたしに負けますか。
entries.note: agent draft 2026-09-28; continue-screen line (reuses dialogue wording where identical)

entries.source:
もう降参?
キミ根性ないね!
entries.note: agent draft 2026-09-28; continue-screen line (reuses dialogue wording where identical)

entries.source: 人の世に、とこしえの闇を‥‥
entries.note: agent draft 2026-09-28; continue-screen line (reuses dialogue wording where identical)

entries.source:
お前には止められまい。あと
一歩のところ、惜しかったな!
entries.ko:
넌 날 못 막는다.
한 걸음 차이로,아깝게 됐군!
entries.note: agent draft 2026-09-28; continue-screen line (reuses dialogue wording where identical)

entries.source:
ワラワに勝とうなどと、
10万年は早かったのう!
entries.note: agent draft 2026-09-28; continue-screen line (reuses dialogue wording where identical)

entries.source:
もう力尽きたか?
それがヒトの限界よの!
entries.note: agent draft 2026-09-28; continue-screen line (reuses dialogue wording where identical)

entries.source:
ははは! 伊達に巫女は
やってないわよ!
entries.note: agent draft 2026-09-28; continue-screen line (reuses dialogue wording where identical)

entries.source:
もう、おしまい?
体力ないわね～、キミ。
entries.note: agent draft 2026-09-28; continue-screen line (reuses dialogue wording where identical)

entries.source: 強い!強すぎるわ、私って!
entries.note: agent draft 2026-09-28; continue-screen line (reuses dialogue wording where identical)

entries.source:
もう、おしまい?
お楽しみは、これからなのに。
entries.note: agent draft 2026-09-28; continue-screen line (reuses dialogue wording where identical)

entries.source:
ヘイ、カモンカモン!
もっと麻雀で、
漢の心を通わすでゴザるよ!
entries.ko:
헤이,컴온,컴온!
더 마작으로
사나이 마음을 나누세!
entries.note: agent draft 2026-09-28; continue-screen line (reuses dialogue wording where identical)

entries.source:
もし勝てたら、
拙者を好きにしてもいいでゴザるよ!
レッツ スパーク!!
entries.ko:
만약 이기면
소인을 마음대로 해도 좋소이다!
렛츠,스파크!!
entries.note: agent draft 2026-09-28; continue-screen line (reuses dialogue wording where identical)
